original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independent explicit-subspace frame recount of PR2979's parent, joint stage one and shipped final words on both providers; isolated five-group invoices and all 16 fixed-partner V45 endpoint subsets; cleanup syntax and buffer names; conditional local-to-complete-invoice boundary.
scope_change_reason: PR2987 already checks chronological packing but assumes native width derivation. This audit closes the new joint rank-seven chronological frame-path implication, without duplicating its cut or treating a surrogate margin as complete physical admission.
bottleneck_link: Tests whether the changed helper boundaries really deliver the claimed local rank savings before pricing their still-separate physical consumer.
stop_rule: Stop after the finite frame implication and source-impact handoff. Do not expand to lowering searches, native or all-size supplier admission.
evidence: RESULT.json; five unittest methods, 18 scoped frame/syntax rejections and a source-byte rejection; README.md distinguishes checked identities from the conditional idle remainder and unverified physical/outer costs.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Automated assistance supported implementation and checks. No independent human review is claimed.

freshness.limits: Metadata/body/comment snapshots are non-atomic and omit arbitrary diffs and unpublished work. No novelty guarantee. PR2987 remains complementary.

open_questions.question: Can the checked final frame paths and PR2987 owner geometry be joined to independently checked native residual/phase and physical costs?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The local shared-overhead benefit is not a complete supplier saving unless the actual consumer, restoration and physical invoice fit.
open_questions.first_step: Bind one lowered V45 helper's native transition recipe to this ledger's chronological events and check both orientations plus its private-buffer endpoint.
open_questions.blocked_by: Native residual/phase, physical storage and prefix/precision bindings are outside this finite frame audit. The complete PR2979 release needs a separately budgeted audit.
